task-conversation.title: Task discussion
task-conversation.boundary: Share a note with people and API collaborators who can access this task. Saving a note does not send instructions to an agent, start work or accept delivery.
task-conversation.draft_guard: Your note or its original receipt is still pending. Send or clear the draft, or check the original note before leaving.
task-conversation.access_changed: Access has changed. Previous notes are hidden; check current access before continuing.
task-conversation.check_parent_access: Check access using the task context controls above.
task-conversation.private_draft: Your unsent draft is kept on this page. You can clear it to leave without posting.
task-conversation.pending_hint: The note may already be saved. Check the same original operation; do not send another copy.
task-conversation.saved: Note saved to the task discussion. No agent or execution was started.
task-conversation.empty: No notes yet. Add context or a handoff note for this task.
task-conversation.read_only: You can read this discussion. Posting is not currently allowed.
task-conversation.placeholder: Share context, a question or a progress note…
task-conversation.invalid_read: The task discussion response could not be verified. Previous content was cleared.
task-conversation.refresh_failed: Current discussion context could not be loaded. Your draft is preserved.
